scope: One completed private Original107 RedStation comparison, Swap1 MITTEL; no overall A3 or release approval
limitations: Inventory is repeated equal reads, not atomic or exhaustive. Unobserved lives/damage/actions cannot be excluded.
Life acquisition times are first observed possession; failed and censored lives retained. Success-only medians are not all-life performance.
Fire_requested and Cecil shots are action requests, not projectile/hit counts. No shooter attribution from HP/armor changes.
Summed positive sampled clamped HP/armor decreases exclude initial spawn clock and overkill; state-loss lower bounds, not actual Damage call totals.
Position polyline is sampled displacement; residence metric uses fixed first-position radius1m, gaps<=0.5s, and is not a stuck verdict.
No Frida Bouncer hook in this comparison; trajectories do not establish a particular native function call.
Diagnostics enabled; only one direction/tier/window. No three matched comparisons, map suite, long-term sync or release qualification.

candidate_cecil.state_field_warning: CecilState liquid is actual m_pstState enum:0 STAND,1 CROUCH,2 SWIM,3 DIVE,4 FALL; not a liquid boolean.

life_format: One compact object per life; first observed useful possession/current/fire-request ages measured from original native spawned_tick; null is not observed.
